question: Must this Astro 7.1 dependency update produce successful exact-head previews on both Vercel projects before it is allowed to merge?
rationale: Local builds are green, but the repository recently rolled back dependency-only changes after both hosted deployments failed, and the current failures cannot be diagnosed without maintainer Vercel access.

options.title: Require hosted proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until both Vercel deployments succeed and representative pages pass a real-browser smoke at the exact head.

options.title: Accept external gate risk
options.body: Merge after confirming through Vercel administration that both failures are unrelated pre-build policy or account gates, explicitly owning the lack of a preview run.

recommendation.title: Require hosted proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until both Vercel deployments succeed and representative pages pass a real-browser smoke at the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Their rollback established the current last-known-good production dependency baseline and the relevant dual-Vercel acceptance standard.
